newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Treasury posts 430 mln real August surplus.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Treasury posts 430 mln real August surplus.

text.p: Brazil's National Treasury posted a 430 million real surplus according to the cash concept in the month of August, the Treasury said in a statement.
It said receipts were 7.656 billion reais and expenditure 7.226 billion reais.

But in operational terms, August showed a deficit of 1.366 billion reais, bringing the operational deficit for the year to end-August to 3.348 billion reais, or 0.69 percent of gross domestic product.

In August last year, the Treasury posted an operational deficit of 1.306 billion reais. In the first eight months of 1995, the operational deficit was 4.115 billion reais, or 0.86 percent of GDP, the statement said.
The primary result for August 1996 was a 201 million real surplus compared with a 711 million real surplus in August 1995. The primary result is the operational balance excluding interest payments.
